canonical_title: Exterior field of view - Rotary-wing air vehicles with single or tandem pilots
subject_group: 9.4.4 External visibility and transmitted visual indications

versions.title_at_revision: Exterior field of view - Rotary-wing air vehicles with single or tandem pilots
versions.text:
Standard: The following are the minimum angles of unimpaired vision available to the pilots from the design eye position in TABLE XV. TABLE XV. Exterior FOV - Rotary-wing air vehicles with single or tandem pilots. 0° azimuth, at least 25° down and 70° up. 20° azimuth left and right, 25° down and 70° up. 30° azimuth left and right, 30° down and 70° up. 90° azimuth left and right, 50° down and 70° up. 135° azimuth left and right, 34° down and 70° up. Mounting structures for the transparency sections do not exceed 2.0 inches in width when projected onto a plane perpendicular to a line between the structure and the design eye position. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analyze vision plots and verify that the total envelope (plus and minus 180 degrees in azimuth and plus and minus 90 degrees in elevation) from each crewmember’s design eye box provides the required clear vision areas as described herein. Vision plots are completed for each flight crew position for all their primary operations. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
  (1) Demonstrate in flight that the external FOV allows the pilots to perform all their primary operations.
